item.title: Resuming a Project
item.description: This week I will try to pickup my side project again after a long hiatus. For this reason I will also try to stay away from social media and distraction. This winter I’ve been very productive, then something kicked in and I’ve dropped everything. Shipping my first side project is part of my 2025 goals and I can’t let it slip again. The aim is to ship it before I’ll go to vacation the 11th of June.
